verdict.rationale: The docs clearly support starting work by tagging Devin in a Slack (or Teams) thread. They also say Devin can take on Linear tickets, though they never show a task being triggered from inside Linear. PR-side activity (Devin Review and Auto-Fix responding to review comments) suggests Devin acts from code-hosting workflows, but none of it names GitHub or GitLab or shows a task being started there. Missing for 10: documented kickoff of tasks from GitHub (e.g., issue or PR mention), any GitLab integration, an explicit Linear-native trigger, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these integrations.
